title: Synthetic settings page / 合成设置页示例

cases.title: Save a display preference / 保存显示偏好
cases.preconditions: Use a synthetic demo account and a test-only settings page. / 使用合成演示账号与专用测试设置页。
cases.fixture: Synthetic account demo-user; initial preference: compact. / 合成账号 demo-user，初始偏好 compact。

steps.action: Open the settings page. / 打开设置页。
steps.expected: The initial preference is compact. / 初始偏好为 compact。

steps.action: Select comfortable and save. / 选择 comfortable 并保存。
steps.expected: A successful save is visible. / 显示保存成功。

cases.expected_result: The saved preference for demo-user is comfortable. / demo-user 的保存偏好为 comfortable。

oracle.reference: Synthetic test fixture specification, preference mapping v1

cases.title: Reload the saved preference / 刷新后读取保存偏好
cases.preconditions: Complete C1 in this round. / 本轮先完成 C1。
cases.fixture: The same synthetic demo-user fixture as C1. / 与 C1 相同的合成 demo-user。

steps.action: Reload the settings page. / 刷新设置页。
steps.expected: comfortable remains selected. / 仍选中 comfortable。

steps.action: Open another view and return to settings. / 切换其他视图后返回设置页。
steps.expected: The saved preference remains visible. / 仍显示保存的偏好。

cases.expected_result: The displayed value matches the independent synthetic preference record. / 展示值与独立合成偏好记录一致。
oracle: Expected preference comes from the synthetic fixture contract, not the value shown by the page.
预期来自合成 Fixture 合同，不能用页面自己的显示值确定预期。
